nadbd17bc7f.headline: Kazakh National Currency Weakens as Market Forces Drive Decline
nadbd17bc7f.summary: The Kazakh national currency, the tenge, has weakened as market forces drove its decline, according to The Astana Times. No further details were provided.
nadbd17bc7f.why: The tenge is Kazakhstan's currency, and its value affects the cost of imports and the returns of foreign investors in Kazakh assets.

n233164e3e7.headline: Tariff of 15 ‘challenging’ but avoids a trade war – Irish enterprise minister
n233164e3e7.summary: Irish enterprise minister Peter Burke said a 15% tariff is challenging but avoids a trade war, adding that the devil is in the detail of the trade agreement finalised on Sunday.
n233164e3e7.why: Tariff levels set under EU trade agreements affect export-heavy sectors such as pharmaceuticals and technology, which are important to Ireland's economy.

nf926f604ee.headline: SoftBank-backed Lenskart plans to file $1 billion IPO this week: Report
nf926f604ee.summary: Lenskart Solutions, supported by SoftBank Group, is preparing to file for an initial public offering of about $1 billion as early as this week, with its valuation being finalised.
nf926f604ee.why: Lenskart is an Indian eyewear retailer, and SoftBank is a major Japanese technology investor. Large IPOs affect listing activity, valuations and investor appetite in India's equity markets.

nbd6c43b551.headline: EU-US trade deal: Ireland 'not exactly celebrating', minister of state says
nbd6c43b551.summary: US President Donald Trump and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced an agreed US tariff of 15% on all EU goods, a deal Irish ministers said was not greeted with celebration.
nbd6c43b551.why: US tariffs on EU goods affect export margins for European manufacturers and the flow of about hundreds of billions of dollars in bilateral trade. The EU and US are two of the largest trading blocs.
nbd6c43b551.why_moved: A 15% US tariff on all EU goods is a significant trade-policy change that affects European exporters' margins and expectations for trade flows.

nea712a0c07.headline: Stock market selloff: NSDL IPO GMP takes hit; what SBI Sec, Anand Rathi say - BusinessToday
nea712a0c07.summary: Rising volatility and selling pressure in broader Indian markets have dented the grey market premium for the listing-bound National Securities Depository. Brokerages SBI Securities and Anand Rathi were cited.
nea712a0c07.why: The grey market premium is an unofficial gauge of expected listing gains, and it tends to fall when broader equity sentiment weakens.
nea712a0c07.why_moved: Rising volatility and selling pressure in broader markets dented the grey market premium for the listing-bound company.

n3a34c9b3f3.headline: Greece Joins Italy, Venice & Bali, Imposes New Tourist Fees On Travellers
n3a34c9b3f3.summary: Greece is introducing tourist fees on travellers to popular islands such as Mykonos and Santorini. The measure is aimed at controlling overtourism.
n3a34c9b3f3.why: Tourism is a major part of the Greek economy, and visitor levies can change travel demand and island hospitality revenue.

n20960b402f.headline: In the news today: Bank of Canada expected to hold key rate again
n20960b402f.summary: The Bank of Canada is expected to keep its key interest rate unchanged at its next decision, according to a Canadian Press roundup.
n20960b402f.why: The Bank of Canada sets the policy rate that anchors Canadian borrowing costs, the Canadian dollar and bond yields. Its decisions shape the outlook for the domestic economy and inflation.

nd9090a703a.headline: Ethiopia's Coffee Sector Sees Significant Growth, Ministry of Agriculture Reports
nd9090a703a.summary: Ethiopia's Ministry of Agriculture announced substantial results from efforts to boost coffee production and productivity, according to a report from a high-level forum at UNFSS+4. Minister Girma Amente spoke on the sector.
nd9090a703a.why: Coffee is a major export commodity for Ethiopia, and its output influences global arabica supply and Ethiopian export earnings.

nb34a520867.headline: 'Partisans' who paralyzed Russian airports have track record of disruptive hacks
nb34a520867.summary: A group claiming responsibility for digital sabotage at Aeroflot, Russia's flagship airline, has a track record of disruptive hacks, Reuters reports.
nb34a520867.why: Aeroflot is Russia's flagship airline and a major carrier, so disruption to its systems affects operations, costs and investor sentiment in the sector.

nd2400ea199.headline: Bank of Canada widely expected to hold key rate steady amid trade uncertainty
nd2400ea199.summary: Economist Avery Shenfeld does not expect the Bank of Canada to cut its benchmark rate at Wednesday's decision. He said a cut would be a "pleasant surprise."
nd2400ea199.why: The Bank of Canada sets the country's benchmark policy rate, which shapes borrowing costs, the Canadian dollar and bond yields across the economy.

n6e370043d0.headline: Shanti Gold International IPO booked nearly 4x on day 2 so far;  GMP holds ground - BusinessToday
n6e370043d0.summary: Shanti Gold International's IPO, priced at Rs 189-199 per share, was booked nearly four times on day two, with subscription running July 25-29 to raise Rs 360.11 crore.
n6e370043d0.why: An initial public offering raises capital for a company by selling new shares to investors, and subscription levels signal investor demand for the listing.

nedad5d8a29.headline: VolkerFitzpatrick appointed to deliver £27.1m Bolton logistics scheme
nedad5d8a29.summary: VolkerFitzpatrick has been appointed by Arrow Capital Partners to build a £27.1m logistics scheme in Bolton, Greater Manchester.
nedad5d8a29.why: Construction contracts for logistics facilities provide revenue to contractors and reflect demand for warehouse space in the UK.

n79ee33d316.headline: AUD/USD Outlook: Greenback Gains as Trade Sentiment Improves
n79ee33d316.summary: The AUD/USD outlook points to a slide as the US dollar rebounds on growing optimism over recent trade deals. The Australian dollar is under pressure.
n79ee33d316.why: The Australian dollar is a liquid commodity-linked currency, so its moves against the US dollar reflect trade sentiment and China-linked demand.

impacts.name: AUD/USD
impacts.why: A rebound in the US dollar on trade-deal optimism weighs on the Australian dollar against the greenback.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n79ee33d316.why_moved: The US dollar rebounded as optimism grew over recent trade deals, pressuring the Australian dollar.

ne806518583.headline: Report: Data centre power demands impacting development viability
ne806518583.summary: A surge in data centre energy use has become a critical factor in project viability, reaching parity with planning and funding issues, according to a report.
ne806518583.why: Data centres are major consumers of electricity, and grid capacity now shapes where AI and cloud infrastructure can be built.

ncd6ef9108c.headline: 'Good day for patients': cheaper medicines on the way
ncd6ef9108c.summary: The federal government is preparing to legislate cheaper medicines, which it describes as cost-of-living relief. The move is presented as a good day for patients.
ncd6ef9108c.why: Changes to drug pricing rules affect pharmaceutical revenues and government health spending. Australia's pharmaceutical benefits system sets prices for subsidised medicines.

nc503949730.headline: India’s revenue foregone in first year of trade pact with UK estimated at ₹4,060 cr: GTRI
nc503949730.summary: A GTRI estimate puts India's revenue foregone in the first year of the UK free trade agreement at ₹4,060 crore. The deal was signed on July 24 and cuts or eliminates tariffs on many goods.
nc503949730.why: Customs revenue changes from trade pacts affect government finances and the tariff-protected positions of domestic producers.

na0f182cb0f.headline: NCGC Advocates for Stronger Partnerships to Enhance Nigeria's Credit Market
na0f182cb0f.summary: The National Credit Guarantee Company has urged banks and financial services stakeholders in Lagos to build partnerships for a more inclusive and resilient credit market. The appeal was made in Lagos.
na0f182cb0f.why: Credit guarantee companies back lending to smaller borrowers, which affects bank loan growth and financial inclusion in the countries they serve.

n7681322e9e.headline: Ajanta Pharma net profit rises 4% to ₹255 cr in June qtr
n7681322e9e.summary: Ajanta Pharma reported a June-quarter net profit that rose 4% to ₹255 crore. Revenue rose to ₹1,303 crore in the quarter.
n7681322e9e.why: Ajanta Pharma is an Indian generic drugmaker, and its quarterly results indicate the health of its sales and margins in pharmaceutical markets.

n07bc170dfb.headline: US to resume grants to Nepal for two key infrastructure projects
n07bc170dfb.summary: The United States will resume funding for two major infrastructure projects in Nepal that had been put on hold after President Donald Trump suspended foreign development aid. The report is from Kathmandu.
n07bc170dfb.why: US development grants fund infrastructure contracts, which affect construction firms and investment flows in recipient countries such as Nepal.

ne021ea3d4b.headline: Grains Importation: A Policy That Threatens Nigeria’s Food...
ne021ea3d4b.summary: The Federal Government has granted import licences for grains to combat rising food prices and boost availability. The decision has drawn criticism.
ne021ea3d4b.why: Grain import policy affects food inflation, local farmers and the agricultural supply chain in Africa's largest economy.

n7a6d2c95a2.headline: Room for rate cuts widens as CPI hits 76-month low, says Govt report
n7a6d2c95a2.summary: India's consumer price inflation fell to 2.1% in June, a 76-month low, giving room for rate cuts. Trade uncertainty, slow credit growth and weak investment cloud the FY26 outlook.
n7a6d2c95a2.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets interest rates, and inflation readings guide its decisions on borrowing costs for the economy.

nec24c773cf.headline: CPA maintains growth outlook as uncertainty mounts
nec24c773cf.summary: The Construction Products Association has maintained its projections for UK construction growth despite mounting economic uncertainty. The forecast was kept unchanged in its latest update.
nec24c773cf.why: Construction output is a key gauge of UK economic activity and is sensitive to interest rates and public investment.

nba7070d56d.headline: Trump weighs whether to allow Taiwan leader’s transit through US
nba7070d56d.summary: President Trump is weighing whether to allow Taiwan's leader to transit through the US. Concerns are growing that the decision could derail trade talks with China and a potential summit with Xi Jinping.
nba7070d56d.why: US-China relations shape global trade flows, supply chains and tariff policy, which affect companies and markets worldwide.

n92565e0859.headline: Electricity supply worsens despite high tariffs
n92565e0859.summary: Citizens across several Nigerian states continue to face erratic electricity supply and soaring bills. Industrial hubs including Kano and Borno are among the affected areas.
n92565e0859.why: Unreliable power and high tariffs raise operating costs for businesses and affect investment conditions in Nigeria's economy.

n96f8496b2d.headline: Nurses in England, Wales and Northern Ireland overwhelmingly reject 3.6% pay rise
n96f8496b2d.summary: Royal College of Nursing members have voted by a large majority against accepting a 3.6% pay rise. The result comes from an indicative vote run by the union.
n96f8496b2d.why: Public sector pay awards shape wage inflation and public spending, and labour disputes in health services can affect government budgets.

n9c29f623f8.headline: ‘Rebased GDP reflects true structure, size of Nigeria’s...
n9c29f623f8.summary: The National Bureau of Statistics released rebased GDP figures showing the economy grew 3.13 percent in the first quarter of 2025.
n9c29f623f8.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy, and GDP revisions change how investors read its growth, size and sector mix. Rebasing updates the economic baseline used for fiscal and monetary planning.

n386a47bfce.headline: Feedgrain Focus: Prices drop as rain arrives
n386a47bfce.summary: Feedgrain prices have dropped as recent rain and more forecast prompted growers to increase selling of current-crop grain, with new-crop sales also rising.
n386a47bfce.why: Feedgrains such as barley and sorghum are key inputs for livestock feed, so their prices affect cattle and feedlot costs. Crop conditions and harvest selling shape their short-term prices.

nfefa8c76b8.headline: Discos owe N2.75trn in tax, salaries, others – Report
nfefa8c76b8.summary: A Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission report says the 11 electricity distribution companies have a combined debt liability of N2.75trn. The debts cover tax, salaries and other obligations.
nfefa8c76b8.why: Electricity distribution companies in Nigeria carry large liabilities that affect the power sector's financing, investment and reliability of supply.

n3ac221d3aa.headline: Real estate sector surges to N41.3tn, boosts economy
n3ac221d3aa.summary: Stakeholders said the recent GDP rebasing shows the real estate sector's valuation has climbed to N41.3tn, a figure they say highlights its rising contribution to the economy.
n3ac221d3aa.why: Nigeria's GDP measures the size of its economy, and rebasing revises the base year used to calculate it, which changes how sector weights and growth rates are read.

ne51b645de8.headline: Regional cattle markets wrap: Cows to lead charge
ne51b645de8.summary: Rainfall over the past week is likely to reset cattle markets in some areas, with growing confidence in southern regions about harvest prospects and timely rain in the north.
ne51b645de8.why: Rainfall and pasture conditions drive livestock supply and cattle prices, which matter to Australian beef producers and exporters.

n233ebcdd40.headline: Megaworld bets big on Cebu growth
n233ebcdd40.summary: Megaworld, through parent Alliance Global Group, is expanding its investment in Cebu. The company cites strong demand and long-term growth.
n233ebcdd40.why: Megaworld is a Philippine property developer, and its large-scale projects make it a bellwether for local real estate demand.

n09320fc601.headline: Asia’s Bitcoin Giant Metaplanet Adds 780 BTC In Massive Crypto Bet
n09320fc601.summary: Japanese investment firm Metaplanet has added 780 bitcoin to its holdings. The reports say the move brings its total holdings above a figure that was cut off in the input.
n09320fc601.why: Metaplanet is a Tokyo-listed firm that holds bitcoin on its balance sheet, so its purchases reflect corporate demand for the cryptocurrency.

n514a2e0410.headline: Ireland’s ‘economic miracle’ at risk from Trump-EU tariffs
n514a2e0410.summary: Crucial sectors of Ireland's economy depend on US multinationals, and the economic miracle could be at risk from the tariffs agreed between Trump and the European Union.
n514a2e0410.why: Ireland hosts many US multinational subsidiaries, so changes in US-EU tariffs can affect corporate tax receipts and export-heavy sectors.

n2baa2ace2e.headline: Wall Street kicks off a week full of potential flashpoints with a whisper
n2baa2ace2e.summary: US stock indexes drifted through a quiet Monday after the United States agreed to tax EU cars and other products at 15%, lower than Trump had earlier threatened.
n2baa2ace2e.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

n02779a9765.headline: Trump agrees 15% ‘best we could get’ tariff deal with EU while markets await Fed
n02779a9765.summary: Trump agreed a 15% tariff deal with the EU, which he described as the best that could be achieved. Trade deals and interest rates are high on the agenda for market watchers this week.
n02779a9765.why: The EU is the United States' largest trading partner bloc, so tariff rates on EU goods affect exporters, importers and currency markets. The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates that influence global asset prices.
n02779a9765.why_moved: The tariff agreement changes the trade cost outlook for EU-US goods flows. Investors are also weighing it alongside the pending Federal Reserve decision on interest rates.

n58016b694c.headline: As Indonesia, Malaysia revive bilateral talks, what will Prabowo and Anwar seek to achieve?
n58016b694c.summary: Indonesia and Malaysia are reviving bilateral talks, with leaders Prabowo and Anwar expected to discuss US trade tariffs and the Cambodia-Thailand dispute. The talks cover bilateral matters alongside trade.
n58016b694c.why: Indonesia and Malaysia are major Southeast Asian economies, and their trade relations are affected by US tariff policy.

n2ffe1527c7.headline: US-China tariff talks may provide clues on a possible Trump-Xi meeting
n2ffe1527c7.summary: Top trade officials have launched a new round of talks aimed at easing tensions over tariffs. The outcome may signal whether a Trump-Xi meeting is possible.
n2ffe1527c7.why: US-China tariffs affect global supply chains, trade flows and corporate earnings for multinationals with exposure to both economies.

naae350d871.headline: Roadmap unveiled to reduce transaction settlement cycle at PSX
naae350d871.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has set February 9, 2026 as the implementation date for moving the Pakistan Stock Exchange from T+2 settlement. A roadmap was unveiled for the transition.
naae350d871.why: Settlement cycles determine how quickly trades are finalised, affecting liquidity and risk for investors on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n68f5eb3add.headline: Nearly Three-Quarters of New Solar and Wind Projects Are Being Built in China
n68f5eb3add.summary: China is accounting for most new solar and wind power construction worldwide, with record-breaking expansion driving a global shift in energy supply.
n68f5eb3add.why: Solar and wind capacity additions shape global demand for panels, turbines and metals, and determine how fast the energy transition proceeds.

nbe804ed4b4.headline: 'Structural unfairness': Premier Eby calls for more federal funding for BC Ferries | Daily Hive | Urbanized
nbe804ed4b4.summary: British Columbia Premier David Eby says the province is not receiving its fair share in federal equalization, including funding for BC Ferries.
nbe804ed4b4.why: Federal equalization transfers shape provincial revenues and public finances. Ferry funding affects the operating budget of a publicly owned ferry network.

n4a48d19a2a.headline: Return-to-office mandates trigger fresh demand for high-end offices in Canada, says Colliers
n4a48d19a2a.summary: Colliers says banks are bringing workers back to offices with high-end workspace, creating renewed demand for premium Canadian office space.
n4a48d19a2a.why: Colliers is a global commercial real estate services firm, and office demand trends shape valuations and leasing markets for Canadian office property.

nc04eb388c2.headline: Why Boston Pizza could be sole survivor among Vancouver restaurant income funds
nc04eb388c2.summary: A&W consolidated with its income fund last year, and Keg unitholders are set to vote this week on a similar move, leaving Boston Pizza as a possible remaining fund.
nc04eb388c2.why: Restaurant income funds distribute royalty income from franchised restaurant brands to unitholders. Consolidation changes structures and payouts for these income trusts.

nbac83917a1.headline: Canada warned not to 'take just any deal' as Trump tariff deadline nears
nbac83917a1.summary: Canada was warned not to 'take just any deal' as a Trump tariff deadline approaches. The report says the United States has agreed on a trade framework, though details in the excerpt are limited.
nbac83917a1.why: Tariffs on Canadian exports affect trade-exposed sectors such as autos, steel, lumber and energy, and shape the outlook for the Canadian dollar and the Bank of Canada.

n48d686b968.headline: Cenovus floated as potential competing bidder for hostile takeover target MEG Energy
n48d686b968.summary: Cenovus Energy has been floated as a potential competing bidder for MEG Energy, which is the target of a hostile takeover bid. The report comes from an oil and gas news outlet.
n48d686b968.why: Cenovus is a large Canadian oil sands producer and MEG is an oil sands producer, so a contested bid would affect consolidation in Alberta's heavy-oil sector.

n691b86ddfe.headline: NSE is still the first achievement and probably the largest I will ever have: Ashish Chauhan
n691b86ddfe.summary: Ashish Chauhan, chief of the National Stock Exchange of India, reflects on his career and the establishment of NSE, highlighting its significance in Indian financial markets.
n691b86ddfe.why: NSE is India's largest stock exchange, critical for capital markets and investor access; leadership insights provide context on market development.

n63ee24bd47.headline: Focus on agri, retail loans drives J&K Bank
n63ee24bd47.summary: J&K Bank posted a record profit of Rs 485 crore for April-June, attributed to focus on agriculture and retail lending.
n63ee24bd47.why: J&K Bank is a regional Indian bank; profit growth driven by key loan segments indicates improving financial performance and regional economic activity.

n667096c2be.headline: UltraTech lines up ₹10,000-crore capex for FY26 to bolster capacity
n667096c2be.summary: UltraTech Cement has allocated up to ₹10,000 crore for capital expenditure in FY26 to boost production capacity and invest in energy and efficiency initiatives.
n667096c2be.why: UltraTech is India's largest cement maker; its capex plans signal growth expectations in infrastructure and construction sectors.
